improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
improve.coach: Down to 20% from 43%. Stay on it.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
improve.coach: 43% of matches overall, down to 20% recently. Keep chipping away.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.
If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.
improve.coach: Worse lately: 60% versus 36%. We'll work on it.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Cool head, quick feet, ball in the onion bag. 57% of your matches. Signature move.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams. 43% of matches. Your calling card.
